name: calc
description: Exact arithmetic on integers and decimals: + - * / % ^ and parentheses, sum(), min(), max(), mean(), abs(), round(). Returns the exact result.

name: table
description: Computes over the last command output read as a table: one row a line, columns split by spaces, a header line names the columns, a row's name is its last column, a total line is left out. op: count, sum, min, max, mean, get (one cell), argmax or argmin (the name of the row), diff (the first of two rows minus the second).

column.description: the column: its header name or its number from 1

rows.description: only the rows with these names

where.description: only the rows whose cell passes the test
